messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — alert fired: redwood-runtime-prod high 5xx rate (alert-id: alert-3241). Grouping: auto-grouped from 7 matches. Trigger: error-rate > 5% for 1m.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> Maya (oncall). Incident: PD-8791. Escalation policy: SRE rotation.

Maya (oncall): Acked PD-8791. I'm looking now. Can someone confirm if this is the gpu cluster or the new quantized runtime?

Arjun (sre): seeing a flood from node-gpu-12 with repeated 'KV cache oom' logs. Might be a single host flapping and spamming alerts.

Jenna (prod-obs): Dashboards: 5xx spike started at 15:02 UTC, peaked at 15:04. Error signature is 503 from inference proxy. Link: https://grafana/internal/d/redwood/runtime?panel=503s (placeholder)

Priya (runtime-eng): Pulling logs. Kernel traces show evictions around the quantized operator when seq_len > 2048. Could be an input distribution shift.

Maya (oncall): Good find. I'm going to mute the noisy duplicate alerts while we investigate to avoid a paging storm. Adding a 10m suppression on alert-key:redwood-runtime-prod:quant-oom.

Maya (oncall): Command I'm running:
```
pd incidents add-note PD-8791 "Suppressed duplicates: suppress alert-key:redwood-runtime-prod:quant-oom for 10m"
pd incidents acknowledge PD-8791 --user "Maya (oncall)"
```

incident-bot: Alerts auto-grouped under alert-3241. Duplicate suppression rule applied: alert-key:redwood-runtime-prod:quant-oom -> 10m mute.

pagerduty-bot: PD-8791 acknowledged by Maya. Escalation timer paused.

Arjun (sre): While suppressed, I suggest we cordon node-gpu-12 from the serving pool and failover traffic. Rolling restart looks safest.

Priya (runtime-eng): Starting a graceful drain on node-gpu-12 now. Command: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-12 && kubectl drain node-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

Jenna (prod-obs): Routing change applied: 98% traffic off node-gpu-12 to standby pool. 5xx rate dropping toward baseline.

incident-bot: Auto-grouping reduced pages from 7 -> 1. Suppression active until 15:14 UTC.

Leo (sre-2nd): I hit the alert due to escalation window (saw PD notification). Joining. Acknowledge and taking on-call handoff in 8m if Maya needs to step away.

Maya (oncall): Handoff note: I have capture of logs + the playback of offending requests in /tmp/replay-PD-8791.tar.gz. If it spikes again, try forcing quantization fallback for that model via config flag `--kernel-fallback=non-quant` on the pool. I'm leaving in 6m.

Leo (sre-2nd): Copy. I'll finish the drain and run `systemctl restart rd-runtime.service` on node-gpu-12 after kube drain completes.

Priya (runtime-eng): Restart done. After restart, memory pressure cleared, no further OOM traces. Canary traffic passed internal test.

Jenna (prod-obs): 5xx at 15:09 UTC is back to baseline. Customer impact: brief 503 window between 15:02-15:06 UTC. Estimated impacted requests: ~0.6% of prod requests across 30min window. No major customers reported outages yet, but monitoring for replays.

Maya (oncall): Adding annotated severity: Sev3 — partial degradation affecting a small subset of requests. Filing initial incident note in PD and pinging CS for potential customer outreach.

incident-bot: PD-8791 -> status: mitigated. Suppression extended automatically by 20m to avoid re-paging during restart flapping.

Arjun (sre): Action items (short):
- postmortem to confirm root cause (quantized kernel OOM)
- add better dedupe rule to group by node + error signature (currently groups by alert name only)
- consider circuit-breaker to fallback to non-quant kernels on memory pressure

Maya (oncall): Handoff to Leo complete. I'm signing off. Leo, please own postmortem and follow-ups.

Leo (sre-2nd): Taking ownership. I'll open the postmortem doc and tag runtime + infra. Link will be posted in PD and here.

incident-bot: Housekeeping: suppressed alert-key:redwood-runtime-prod:quant-oom until 15:34 UTC. Auto-grouping rule logged as rule-agg-12. Suggestion: create a suppression policy that triggers only when same-host > 3x in 1m to avoid masking multi-node incidents.

Maya (oncall): Quick reminder to update the oncall runbook with the `--kernel-fallback` flag and the drain checklist.

Leo (sre-2nd): Will do. Adding a temporary watch to the alert to alert only after dedupe check passes (change threshold to 'unique_hosts > 1 OR error-rate > 7%').

Priya (runtime-eng): Follow-up: we'll push a candidate hotfix to quant kernel memory checks in the next patch and run heavier canaries.

Jenna (prod-obs): Closing note: no further pages in the suppression window. Tagging incident as "mitigated, follow-up required".

Maya (oncall): :white_check_mark: Thanks team.

Leo (sre-2nd): I'll post the postmortem link when created and schedule a 30m blameless review.

incident-bot: Cleanup: auto-closed alert instances linked to alert-3241, archived suppression (rule-agg-12) will persist per policy.

Maya (oncall): End of thread.
